MaintenanceInput.description:
Create/full-update payload for a maintenance window. kind-dependent
required fields are enforced in the model validator; aware datetimes are
normalized to the service's naive-UTC convention.
MaintenanceInput.title: MaintenanceInput

delete.description: Deletes the agent API key of a server.

post.description:
Generates a new agent API key for a server.

The raw key is only returned on creation. For an existing key it must be
regenerated (DELETE + POST).
Agent pushes metrics directly to the monitoring service.

get.description: Lists all checks, optionally filtered by server_id.

post.description: Creates a new check and registers it in the scheduler.

get.description: Returns a single check with its state.
Type-specific time-series metrics + status timeline from VictoriaMetrics.

put.description: Full update of a maintenance window (same payload as create).

delete.description: Cleans up all monitoring data of a server.

get.description: Returns all check states for the dashboard.
Returns check states for a specific server.

Summary: count per status. Dict response (aggregate, not a list) —
deliberately unpaginated.
Lists all templates with their server and tag assignments.
Returns all template assignments of a server.

post.description:
Reconcile materialized tag assignments now. Called by the server after
inventory changes (create/update/delete); the scheduler runs the same
reconciliation as a 15-minute safety net.

delete.description: Deletes a template — removes all generated checks/alerts on all servers.

get.description: Returns a single template with its assignments.

put.description: Updates a template — triggers a live sync to all assigned servers.

post.description: Assigns a template to a server — creates all checks/alerts.

Binds a template to a server tag. Materialization into per-server
assignments happens in tag_sync (triggered separately).

delete.description:
Removes a template→tag binding. Materialized per-server assignments are
cleaned up by the next tag_sync run.
Removes a template assignment — deletes all associated checks/alerts.
